defects_argued.quote: As rightly pointed out by the learned counsel for the petitioner the service effected by the respondent through on-line portal cannot be deemed to be sufficient service.

In the light of the above, this Court has no hesitation to hold that the impugned order is an ex parte order as the same suffers from violation of principles of natural justice and is liable to be aside on account of the fact that the petitioner has not been heard before passing such order.

outcome.quote: In the result, the Writ Petition is allowed on the aforesaid terms.
